about.label: About me
body: I live in Ankara and work as a frontend developer at InspireIT. Previously, I worked at GuruDesk and did a web development internship at Bilgeweb.
Much of my work is on existing interfaces. I move repeated code into shared components so the same change doesn’t need making in several places. I also work on pages that take too long to load.
On this site, I experimented with scroll animation. The moving layers and the dial further down the page are part of that work.

craft.heading: How can I help?
craft.note: I can build a site from scratch or join an existing project.

items.name: Interfaces
items.what: Marketing sites, web apps and dashboards.
items.how: I turn designs into responsive pages. Shared elements become reusable components.
items.when: You need a new website or an interface for your app.
items.honesty: I can work from your existing designs.

items.name: Improvements
items.what: Slow pages and interfaces that have become difficult to update.
items.how: First, I find what’s slowing the page down. After updating the code, I run the same measurements again.
items.when: Your site is slow on mobile or small updates take too long.
items.stack: Lighthouse, Web Vitals, profiling, accessibility audits
items.honesty: We can start with your current project.

items.name: Animation
items.what: Scroll animations, page transitions and interactive sections.
items.how: I check animations on mobile too, and make sure the page stays usable with reduced motion enabled.
items.when: You want to use animation to explain a product or idea.
items.stack: GSAP ScrollTrigger, Lenis, CSS scroll-driven animation
